output.answer_markdown: Automatic Data Processing reported FY2021 net cash from operating activities of $3.1 billion [1], and Workday reported $1.7 billion [2], both as originally filed. Workday's FY2021 figure was later restated, and the figure used here is as originally filed. Automatic Data Processing's figure was therefore $1.4 billion higher [3].

claims.text: Automatic Data Processing reported FY2021 net cash from operating activities of $3.1 billion.
Workday reported FY2021 net cash from operating activities of $1.7 billion as originally filed; this figure was later restated.
Automatic Data Processing's FY2021 net cash from operating activities exceeded Workday's, as originally filed, by $1.4 billion.
